$comment: Advisories intentionally tolerated while the app is pinned to next@16.2.6 + next-auth@5.0.0-beta.31, the highest versions the DEPRECATED @cloudflare/next-on-pages (peer 'next: >=14.3.0 && <=15.5.2', bundled @vercel/next@4.12.4) can build. Verified by Pages builds: bumping next to 16.3.5 (builds 8f049372/00afe73c) and next-auth to beta.32/@auth/core 0.41.3 (preview 7f7aab57) each FAIL the Cloudflare Pages build. All 17 next advisories are patched in next >=16.3.8 (ranges '>=16.0.0 <16.3.8'); no 16.2.x drop-in exists. The blocking CI gate (.github/audit-gate.mjs) still fails on any NEW (unlisted) advisory that rides on the critical 'next' package.
removal_condition: Migrate off @cloudflare/next-on-pages to OpenNext or vinext on Workers, then bump next to a patched >=16.3.8 and next-auth to a patched beta (>=beta.32 / @auth/core 0.41.3+) and EMPTY this allowlist. Until then these are accepted, tracked risk.

mitigations.GHSA-8fpg-xm3f-6cx3: Auth fail-open existence check + email issues partially offset by H5 getCurrentUser() live-role re-validation (session.ts); migrate to patched @auth/core to fully close.
mitigations.GHSA-6gpp-xcg3-4w24: Next middleware/proxy bypass: app's real authorization is enforced per-route via auth()/getCurrentUser(), not solely middleware, limiting blast radius.
mitigations.GHSA-vcvr-r3jv-pc5j: next/og ImageResponse RCE: UNREACHABLE in this app — no import of next/og/ImageResponse and no opengraph-image/twitter-image routes (verified by grep). Affects the pinned next@16.2.6 (unpatchable until off next-on-pages). Re-check: if any dynamic-OG/feature ever renders ImageResponse, remove the pin workaround and bump immediately.
mitigations.GHSA-cjq9-62q9-8jv4: SSRF in Image Optimization API: every <Image> in the app passes `unoptimized` (bypasses /_next/image entirely) and next.config.ts remotePatterns is a tight allowlist (static.wixstatic.com + the project's own R2 host). Re-check: if any optimized <Image> with a wildcard/remote pattern is added, treat as exploitable.
mitigations.GHSA-2xp9-vwfh-vxw4: Image Optimization AVIF RCE: same as SSRF — Image Optimization API is not exercised (`unoptimized` everywhere; pinned remotePatterns). Unreachable until optimization is enabled.
mitigations.GHSA-f87g-xv8r-7p7x: App Router metadata image routes dynamicParams disclosure: UNREACHABLE — no opengraph-image/twitter-image/icon metadata routes exist in src/app (verified by grep).
mitigations.GHSA-4jqv-mc3x-m676: SSG/ISR cache poisoning (self-hosted): app is dynamic/edge (client-rendered polling; edge runtime), so SSG/ISR page caching is not used. Effectively unreachable.
mitigations.GHSA-mcj8-r9mp-w47p: SSG/ISR cache poisoning → cross-user substitution/DoS: same rationale as GHSA-4jqv — no SSG/ISR in this app.
mitigations.GHSA-39w2-rjm5-chcv: Dev server MCP endpoint info disclosure: development-only code path; not present in the production edge build.
